changeSet.author: McNamee
changeSet.sql: CREATE or ALTER FUNCTION [dbo].[GetSecurityAssetUid] ( @SecurityAsset varchar(1), @SecurityAssetID int ) RETURNS TABLE with Schemabinding AS RETURN ( select A.[UID] from [dbo].[Asset] A where A.[Object] = 'Resource' and A.[ObjectID] = @SecurityAssetID and @SecurityAsset = 'R' union select A.[UID] from [dbo].[Asset] A where A.[Object] = 'Group' and A.[ObjectID] = @SecurityAssetID and @SecurityAsset = 'G' union select A.[UID] from [dbo].[Asset] A where A.[Object] = 'Organization' and A.[ObjectID] = @SecurityAssetID and @SecurityAsset = 'O' )
